title: The Jacquard loom
episode: How an 1803 Jacquard Loom Led to Computer Technology
place: Statue of Joseph Marie Jacquard, Croix-Rousse
description: Joseph Marie Jacquard, a Lyon weaver’s son, built a loom in the early 1800s that wove complex patterns from chains of punched cards. The idea later inspired early computers. His statue stands on the Croix-Rousse, the silk workers’ hill.

title: Ampère
episode: The Newton of Electricity: The Genius and Tragedy of André-Marie Ampère
description: André-Marie Ampère, born in Lyon in 1775, worked out the laws linking electricity and magnetism. The unit of electric current, the amp, is named after him. His statue stands on Place Ampère.
